  PROBLEM: The "nothing committed" sentinel regex `^- (none|commit skipped)([[:space:]]|$)` also matches a real committed-path line such as `- none notes.md`, because the commit step writes `- <path>` per file (scripts/review_commit_changes.sh:664-670, `printf -- '- %s\n'`), so the script cannot tell the `- none` sentinel apart from such a path.
  WHY: With a `not-edited` summary and a `sandbox-excluded path` bullet, the script appends the non-retryable `review_editor_sandbox_path_excluded` marker even though a file was committed, and the gate cap can block that head on the next dispatch; severity disagreement: google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite rated MAJOR (mapped to high), while minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash rated NIT (z-ai_glm-5_3-flash calls the trigger "contrived but demonstrable"); highest used.

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===
- scripts/review_autofix_step_post_editor_summary.sh:197 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The regex for identifying an empty commit (grep -v -E '^[[:space:]]*$|^- (none|commit skipped)([[:space:]]|$)' ) incorrectly matches files named "none..." or "commit skipped...".
  WHY: If a PR commits "none notes.md" and the editor summary reports "not-edited" with a "sandbox-excluded path" finding, the script wrongly writes the failure marker and can block a head that had a valid committed fix.
- HARDENING: scripts/review_autofix_step_post_editor_summary.sh:196
  PROBLEM: If COMMITTED_FILES_FILE is empty, the "nothing committed" grep check might behave unexpectedly depending on whether the file exists and is readable.
  WHY: The suggested fix is `[ -s "${COMMITTED_FILES_FILE}" ] && [ -r "${COMMITTED_FILES_FILE}" ] && ! grep ...`. HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
=== END FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- scripts/review_autofix_step_post_editor_summary.sh:line ~201 — `! grep -q -v -E '^[[:space:]]*$|^- (none|commit skipped)([[:space:]]|$)' "${COMMITTED_FILES_FILE}"` | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The sentinel regex matches any committed-path line that starts with `none ` (e.g. `none notes.md`, `none file.py`), so `- none notes.md` is classified as a "nothing committed" placeholder.
  WHY: With a contradictory "not-edited" claim and a `sandbox-excluded path` bullet, the step silently treats the line as `- none`, appends the non-retryable marker, and routes the run through the gate cap on the next dispatch.
- HARDENING: scripts/review_autofix_step_post_editor_summary.sh positive-evidence guard around line 201 (`sandbox_excluded_nothing_committed` block)
  PROBLEM: An empty `COMMITTED_FILES_FILE` is classified as "nothing committed", although the issue spec says unset or missing means "unknown, no marker".
  WHY: The suggested fix is to add `-s "${COMMITTED_FILES_FILE}"` to the condition and to drop the empty-string case from the parametrize list of `test_placeholder_committed_files_count_as_nothing_committed` in `tests/test_review_editor_sandbox_excluded_escalation.py` (~1 line of shell plus 1 test line). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1

  PROBLEM: The committed-file check treats any manifest line beginning `- none ` as a no-commit sentinel, while the commit script records committed paths as `- <path>`, so a committed file named `none notes.md` passes the check.
  WHY: If the summary says `not-edited` and also reports a `sandbox-excluded path` finding, this false no-commit result appends the non-retryable marker, and the next dispatch caps that head as though the editor made no change.

=== FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_3-flash ===

  PROBLEM: Committed paths are written as one `- <path>` line per file (scripts/review_commit_changes.sh:664-670, `printf -- '- %s\n'`), so `- none notes.md` matches the sentinel regex and `sandbox_excluded_nothing_committed` is set to 1 even though a file was committed.
  WHY: The grep cannot tell `- none` (the marker written at review_commit_changes.sh:151/529) from a path that starts with `none `, so a non-retryable `review_editor_sandbox_path_excluded` marker can block a head that did receive a committed edit; the reviewer calls the trigger contrived but demonstrable.
- HARDENING: scripts/review_autofix_step_post_editor_summary.sh lines 201-202 (COMMITTED_FILES_FILE evidence check)
  PROBLEM: A zero-byte COMMITTED_FILES_FILE counts as "nothing committed", while an unset or missing file is treated as unknown with no marker; the commit step never intentionally writes an empty file.
  WHY: The suggested fix is to add `-s "${COMMITTED_FILES_FILE}"`, plus a `None` committed case in tests/test_review_editor_sandbox_excluded_escalation.py (estimated 1 line changed). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
